description: This file is a C header (.h) file defining internal API prototypes for the Bbhm Diagnostic Executor component within a Broadband Home Manager system. It contains function declarations related to diagnostic parameter management, results retrieval, and control operations like engage and cancel.

methods.name: BbhmDiageoSetDiagParams
methods.description: Sets diagnostic parameters using provided handle references.

methods.name: BbhmDiageoGetResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result object for diagnostics.

methods.name: BbhmDiageoGetResultTimeStamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp associated with the diagnostic result.

methods.name: BbhmDiageoCopyDiagParams
methods.description: Copies diagnostic parameters from one handle to another.

methods.name: BbhmDiageoEngage
methods.description: Engages or activates the diagnostic process.

methods.name: BbhmDiageoResultQueryTask
methods.description: Performs a query related to diagnostic results.
